''See also: [[Heartlander Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Heartlanders are a group of people characterized by their dark skin. They originate from the [[Heartland{{!}}Heartlands]], an area once ruled by [[Nakothi]] that is considered the birthplace of humanity. Within the social hierarchy and culture, Heartlanders are associated with specific customs, such as wearing soft shorts for sleeping. Some individuals from this group are noted for their affinity for luxurious attire, often wearing elegant dresses, fine silks, or pristine white suits and hats. Certain prominent Heartlanders are also known for wearing extensive gold jewelry and gemstones on their bodies, and some possess distinctive physical traits like hair styled in numerous small braids or facial scars.}}
